data.name: Ambrish
data.gender_notes: Ambrish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ambhu’ meaning water and ‘rish’ meaning master or sage. This name signifies one who is immortal or imperishable, a wise and enlightened soul. In Hindu mythology, Ambrish is the name of a sage who had the power to control the elements of water and fire. The name Ambrish carries the meaning “Immortal, Imperishable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ambrish usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, imperishable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine qualities of wisdom, enlightenment, and mastery over the elements.
data.etymology: Ambrish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Imperishable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambrish total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
